interpretation_hint: A view one participant states on a topic: a proposal, support, doubt or objection. Write the view in the field `statement` (never `title`). Every participant who says something substantive about a topic gets their own Position, so a topic discussed by three people usually has two to four Positions. Always link it to its DiscussionTopic with `about`.

properties.name: statement
properties.interpretation_hint: The view in one sentence, in the speaker's terms.

properties.name: holder
properties.interpretation_hint: The participant's name exactly as in the transcript's `speaker` field. If every turn has the same speaker (one recording without speaker labels), infer the person from the content: who is addressed by name, who says 'I will' about their own work; write 'unknown' if you cannot tell.

properties.name: stance
properties.interpretation_hint: One of: proposes, supports, questions, objects.

properties.name: about
properties.interpretation_hint: The DiscussionTopic this position is about.
